recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore FHIR-5622's original CodeableConcept issue.code shape unless the work group explicitly reverses FHIR-8449 or adopts a new OperationOutcome coding model.
issue_request: FHIR-5622 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OperationOutcome change request from DSTU1 asking to replace the then-current OperationOutcome issue type Coding with a CodeableConcept so senders could include a required base IssueType code plus more specific local codes.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 62514b59c1089b4bde7edf6e204c9c1957484a9c (svn revision 4488) applied FHIR-5622 by changing OperationOutcome.issue.type to OperationOutcome.issue.code, making it 1..1, changing its type to CodeableConcept, and updating the example.
additional_context: FHIR-8449 was a later Published/Persuasive with Modification decision for the same OperationOutcome issue coding model. It resolved to change issue.code back to primitive code with the required IssueType binding, add issue.details as the CodeableConcept extension point for more specific local codes/details, and rename the old details text to diagnostics. Commit 8f9d370156502bee2cc1371a3c97f28a1588ed2a applied that later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/operationoutcome/structuredefinition-OperationOutcome.xml defines issue.code as primitive code with required IssueType, issue.details as CodeableConcept, and issue.diagnostics as string; current examples use primitive issue.code with optional details content.

related_jiras.note: Published later decision for the same OperationOutcome issue coding element that intentionally moved local CodeableConcept coding from issue.code to issue.details.
